description: The flattened style of one node, shaped for writing code: hex fills / strokes / effects, corner radii, typography, and auto-layout translated into CSS flexbox terms (display, direction, gap, padding, justifyContent, alignItems, sizing) plus how the node behaves inside its parent layout (flexGrow, alignSelf, margin). Shared styles and variable bindings are named whenever they resolve inside this file.

file.description: Path to the .fig / .figma file (absolute, or relative to the server CWD).

guid.description: Node guid, e.g. "2:1339". A Figma node-id or link works too.

includeRuns.description: For TEXT nodes, also return styled runs (default false).

name: fig_style
title: Resolved style of a node
